prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Atlanta after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Atlanta for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can give you a short list of specific firms to call right away and why each is worth contacting — plus what to ask on the phone and next steps. If you want a more tailored list (near your neighborhood or for a specific injury level), tell me your ZIP or what happened and I’ll refine it.

Call these (general Atlanta options):

1) Morgan & Morgan — Atlanta office
- Why: One of the largest plaintiff personal-injury firms in the U.S.; lots of resources for investigations, medical experts and handling complex insurance fights. Good if your claim may involve serious injuries, lost wages, or multi-party liability.
- What they’re good for: aggressive negotiation, resources for catastrophic cases, contingency-fee arrangements.

2) The Cochran Firm Atlanta
- Why: Nationally recognized trial lawyers with experience handling serious injury and wrongful-death cases. Often trial-ready and known for high-profile representation.
- What they’re good for: cases where insurance companies are likely to resist or where trial may be necessary.

3) John Foy & Associates (John Foy)
- Why: Long-established Atlanta plaintiff firm with local courtroom experience and a strong track record in auto-accident cases in Georgia.
- What they’re good for: local knowledge of Atlanta-area courts, hospitals and medical providers, and plaintiff-side experience.

What to check when you call (10 quick questions)
- Do you take car-accident cases on contingency? (ask the % and whether expenses are deducted before/after settlement)
- Who will be the main attorney handling my case (name/years of experience)? Who does the daily work?
- Do you handle cases like mine, and can you give an example of a recent result?
- How long do cases like this usually take with your firm?
- Do you have trial experience in Fulton/DeKalb/Cobb County courts? (whichever is relevant)
- How will you handle medical bills/medical liens and work with my treatment providers?
- Are there any upfront costs I would be responsible for?
- How do you communicate (phone/email/text) and how often will I hear updates?
- Do you offer a free case review/consultation? Do I need to bring anything?
- Are there negative outcomes or limits I should be aware of?

Immediate next steps
- Get basic info together before you call: photos, police report number (if any), dates, medical records/appointments, insurance info, and names of witnesses.
- Call at least 3 firms from the list (or more). Compare answers on fee structure, who will handle the case, and what they say about potential value/timeline.
- If you want, paste the short summary of what happened and your ZIP code and I’ll give a more tailored list of 4–6 firms near you with contact info and which one might fit your priorities best.

A quick note: I’m not forming an attorney-client relationship; confirm current contact info and terms when you call. If you want, tell me your ZIP and a 1–2 sentence summary of injuries and I’ll refine the list and draft a short script you can use when you call.
